gaps.explanation: deny + -ing or having + past participle: denied doing/having done. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: She keeps ___ about the exam results.
The children are looking forward to ___ Father Christmas.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: looking forward to meeting.

gaps.sentence: Instead of ___ , why don't you ask for help?
I regret ___ you that the flight has been cancelled.
gaps.explanation: regret + to-infinitive (formal announcements); regret + -ing = be sorry about the past.

gaps.sentence: I can't imagine ___ in a tiny village again.
I could hear the neighbours ___ again last night.
gaps.explanation: hear + object + -ing = hear an action in progress: hear them arguing.

gaps.sentence: The children were excited ___ the circus.
gaps.explanation: 'Excited to see' — the to-infinitive follows the adjective.
